errors.text_span: Всички сектори са визуално подредени по низходящ ред на големината им, започвайки от най-големия в дясната част на диаграмата.
errors.evidence: The description claims that all sectors are visually arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest one on the right. This is incorrect. While the largest sector (36.3%) is on the right, the subsequent sectors in a clockwise direction are 13.3%, 14.4%, 26.4%, 5.5%, and 4.1%. This sequence is not in descending order, as 13.3% is followed by a larger value of 14.4%.
